_doc: Say-this-not-that table for the TTS normalizer (skills/script-gates/scripts/normalize_narration.py; v2 port of pipeline/tts_lexicon.json, also read by validate_storyboard.py). Producer-editable. After editing run: python3 skills/script-gates/scripts/normalize_narration.py --self-test
_rules: say: exact token -> spoken form. Applied FIRST, longest key first, case-sensitive, on word boundaries. Multi-word keys are allowed ('RTX 4090').
Values must contain NO digits and no 2+ letter ALL-CAPS runs, or later passes will re-process them.
keep: tokens left exactly as-is; Kokoro already says these correctly.
units: numeric suffix -> spoken unit name. Matched as <number><unit> with optional space or hyphen.

Anything ALL-CAPS (2+ chars) that is neither in keep nor say gets spelled out letter-by-letter as a safety net, and the storyboard validator raises an advisory so a human can add a real pronunciation here.
